'''Atren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] son of [[Darth Atroph]] and a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] himself who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during [[3641 BBY]], he tasked an Imperial hero to free a group of insane [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] being guarded by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Averon]]. Atren hoped that the maddened Jedi would bring further chaos to the [[Belsavis prison]] once released.<ref name="Freeing" />
